user_prompt: Generate a list of local points of interest, cultural landmarks, and tourist attractions for Zion National Park (October 18, 2026), excluding hikes, with clickable links to source material and corresponding Google Maps content. Prefer specific place pages and precise Google Maps links over generic listing pages. Include a rating and a short descriptive note for each item when available, using a clear numeric format for the rating. Keep only highly rated items (>4.3), include a mixture of experiences, and keep only places likely open on the indicated dates. Include only suggestions with reliable clickable links. Also specifically verify and include, if real: The Narrows; Emerald Pools Trail; Canyon Overlook Trail.
